title: Steepy
summary: STEEPY, adjective Having a steep or precipitous declivity; as steepy crags; a poetical word. No more, my goats, shall I behold you climb the steepy cliffs.

inlines.v: STEEPY, adjective Having a steep or precipitous declivity; as steepy crags; a poetical word. No more, my goats, shall I behold you climb the steepy cliffs.
